Theme 028 · Material & 3D

Marble-Run Machine

A kraft-cardboard marble run fills the square. Every marble is a data point rolling through taped, stencilled gates; Pulse is the machine itself, and when one marble fails a gate a flipper diverts it into a coral review cup where a human decides.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Track — a stroked SVG path with cardboard edge, face and groove layers
  • Marble — teal glass sphere with specular dot and contact shadow; one per event
  • Gate flap — a stencilled arch whose flap ticks teal when a marble passes
  • Diverter flipper — swings to route a failing marble out of the main run
  • Review cup — the coral checkpoint where the human decides
  • Finish bell — brass bell that rings for “all clear” — the CTA beat

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Path roll — MotionPath with power1.in on descents, rotation tied to distance travelled; gate crossings are timed to beats
  • Domino chain — each gate's flap tick triggers the next marble release — one gate per beat at 120 BPM
  • Flipper snap — 0 → 40° in 0.12 s, back.out(3), exactly on the snare; the marble's drop into the cup lands on the following downbeat

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

“Automatic checks plus one human gate” becomes a physical machine anyone can read with the sound off, and it cuts naturally to the beat (every gate is a hit). Physical toy machines have a proven advertising pedigree. Risk: clutter — cap it at 4 gates and 1 diverter so the one coral marble stays the hero.

Adapt to your product: Name the gates after the checks your product runs (tests, fraud rules, SLAs) and make the review cup your product's approval step; everything that passes rings the bell.
